title: The Big Travel Plan
setting: A bright living room in a British house with a large world map on the wall.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: Anna, a young girl with long blonde hair and a yellow sweater

sentences.en: Ben and Anna are children in Britain.
sentences.zh: 本和安娜是住在英国的孩子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt and Anna, a young girl with long blonde hair and a yellow sweater stand in front of a red-brick British house.

sentences.en: They look at a big map of the world.
sentences.zh: 他们看着一张大大的世界地图。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt and Anna, a young girl with long blonde hair and a yellow sweater look at a large world map on the living room wall.

sentences.en: They want to travel to many countries.
sentences.zh: 他们想去很多国家旅行。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt and Anna, a young girl with long blonde hair and a yellow sweater sit on the sofa with a suitcase, dreaming, in front of the world map.

sentences.en: Ben wants to visit Japan and Sweden.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt points at Japan and then at Sweden on the world map.

sentences.en: Anna likes Italy, Portugal and Switzerland.
sentences.zh: 安娜喜欢意大利、葡萄牙和瑞士。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna, a young girl with long blonde hair and a yellow sweater points at Italy, Portugal and Switzerland on the world map.

sentences.en: Their first trip goes west, across England.
sentences.zh: 他们的第一次旅行是向西穿过英格兰。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt and Anna, a young girl with long blonde hair and a yellow sweater trace a line westward across England on the map with their fingers.

sentences.en: Anna is a little afraid of flying.
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna, a young girl with long blonde hair and a yellow sweater looks worried at a toy plane in her hand, next to Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt.

sentences.en: A friendly driver takes them there by car.
sentences.zh: 一位友好的司机开车带他们去那里。
sentences.scene_prompt: A friendly driver smiles at Ben, a young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt and Anna, a young girl with long blonde hair and a yellow sweater in the back seat of a car on a country road.
